purpose: Verify every source endpoint for the 96 later-range pair IDs against the original 40-batch source CSVs and the current 6 November staging exports.

results.source_provenance_notes: All 178 rows identify original EDUKEN-authored content and state they were not copied from past question papers.
results.licensing_notes: All 178 rows state original content/no third-party question text reproduced; academic review remains required.
source_name_variants: blank on a subset; provenance_notes still explicitly state original EDUKEN-authored content

target_crosswalk.note: The 68 retained targets are not automatically moved to held; semantic disposition and qualified review decide which are true duplicates.

methodology: For each unique endpoint, fetched the original batch CSV row using physical CSV line numbering, found its matching row in the 6 November retained or held export, and compared all 18 source columns exactly (subject, topic, subtopic, stem, four options, answer, explanation, difficulty, exam type, source type/name/year, provenance/licensing notes and status). Batch numbers were normalized from zero-padded source_batch fields.
limitations: This verifies source-row existence, exact source/staging content equality and the source CSV's original-authorship metadata.
It does not independently prove authorship beyond the repository's source metadata, nor determine the introducing Git commit for every row.
The 96 pair relationships still require semantic duplicate-versus-related-skill disposition and qualified subject/syllabus approval.
The 68 retained target locations remain in retained exports until confirmed duplicates are approved for holdout.
